_doc: Asset manifest fragment for what every weapon line shares (merged into asset_manifest.json by tools/wzimport and AssetManifest; docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md 4.1; #154). The weapon afterimages of the non-Warrior families (Character.wz/Afterimage, variant 0 only: WeaponInfo.AFTERIMAGE_VARIANT; the swordOS, swordTL, swordTS, axe, spear and poleArm ones are in warrior.json with the Warrior weapons) with the hit sparks of the sword and mace families (hit.img), the whole Sound.wz/Weapon.img (every weapon info/sfx name: swordL, swordS, mace, poleArm, spear, bow, cBow, tGlove, knuckle, gun, barehands) and one representative weapon item per non-Warrior family for the weapon gallery and tests (dagger, bow, crossbow, claw, knuckle, gun; the creation weapons stay in the main file, the wands and staves in magician.json, the Warrior weapons in warrior.json). Ammo items (#155) are added here too. The swordOL, mace, hit.img and Weapon.img entries are moved here from the main file.
